title: Benchmark registry (Content-Grounding §6.3)
description: Governed 'what good looks like' references — the third comparison axis. Each entry references an existing KPI and is CORROBORATED by ≥2 independent public sources (single-source industry figures are unreliable), with the observed range recorded.

kpi_id.description: Must resolve to a governed KPI under core/kpi_catalog/kpis/ (Golden Thread).

scope.description: Population the benchmark describes (sector, geography, segment).

metric.description: Which point of the reference distribution the value is.

value.description: Consensus/headline value in the KPI's unit.

range.description: Observed spread across sources — a benchmark is a distribution, not a point.

sources.description: ≥2 independent public sources corroborating the value (single-source figures are unreliable for industry benchmarks).

citation.description: Publisher, year, and the figure reported — no bare assertions.

as_of.description: ISO date the source was recorded/verified.
